status: Locally frozen after synthetic/pinned contracts and source preparation, before new detector, tracker or GT-content evaluation. Prior MOT outcomes known. Not external preregistration.
selection: First four training sequence identifiers in lexical order, complete sequences; no source change after any detector/tracker/GT output. No prior project KITTI runs found in public validation records. Independent from MOT reference histories, not independent detector/runtime.
source_preparation: Official original PNG members with ZIP CRC checks, contiguous zero-based filenames, per-image SHA256 manifest; FFV1 bgr0 at original 10Hz, all decoded frames pixel-identical to PNGs. No resize, crop, resampling or lossy encoding.

rules.base: Confirmed selected weak row age>=2; same-column competitor score >= original weak gate and selected-minus-competitor <= unchanged .05. Active=confirmed and pre-update age1; retained/unconfirmed rows logged but cannot qualify.
rules.past_support: Both hypotheses have nonempty recorded accepted-observation histories before this decision. On selected hypothesis last accepted observation strictly before decision, competitor must be in same stage, active confirmed, AND have its own distinct accepted observation; competitor score >= that stage original gate and signed gap <=.05. Check immutable keys. Missing comparison/observation is unknown, never filled or treated as proof of either identity. Birth keys unavailable; do not invent them. No native-ID joins, GT, future +1..+30 or fitted duration.
rules.protection: Competitor currently has no other accepted weak update. Force it onto selected column and solve remaining unfiltered one-to-one assignment with original gate afterwards: every OTHER original accepted row/detection pair must remain and accepted count must not decrease. Selected missed-row update deliberately excluded; its deferral is tested as a harm. No opportunity-cost cutoff/equality requirement; solver-returned alternative only.
rules.action: Four factorial arms: no veto, past support alone, protection alone, conjunction on SAME competitor. Any qualifying competitor vetoes the selected edge once. Decisions simultaneous from unmodified original matching. Only remove selected edge, return its row/column unmatched; never install alternative or rematch. Weak input unchanged and deferred detection remains upstream output ID -1.
rules.history: Each arm owns its causal accepted-edge history; after decisions record only actually accepted high/weak observations (frame, original detection index). Strong object references prevent ownership reuse. No reference-history transfer after divergence.
rules.unchanged: Weak detections/continuation, births, lifecycle, activation .3/high .6/buffer30/confirmation2, YOLO26n 8.4.176 CPU confidence .1/imgsz640/person0/max_det64/NMS.7/weight hash, source FPS10, app/worker/defaults. Buffer30 is 3 s at source10Hz, not previous 30Hz timing.

harm_gate.per_scene: FN, FP, IDSW, Frag must not increase; IDF1/HOTA must not decrease (exact deterministic comparison). Added paired GT-frame FN and IDSW must BOTH be zero; improvements elsewhere cannot offset them. Zero-GT scenes retain false-positive/harm checks but cannot establish identity benefit.
harm_gate.quality: Actual veto and nonzero evaluated pedestrian GT required for effective exposure; strict improvement in at least one FN/FP/IDSW/IDF1/HOTA measure with all harm conditions passing.
harm_gate.group: All four scene harm gates pass; at least two distinct scenes have effective exposure; every effectively exposed scene passes strict quality gate. Report every arm/scene, all negatives and failures; aggregate cannot override a scene harm. No default promotion or release acceptance.
harm_gate.paired_keys: GT-frame FN/IDSW on official preprocessed stable GT ordering; FP keyed by immutable cached detection with coordinate/confidence reconciliation. Paired counts must reconcile to official CLEAR.
harm_gate.limitations: These gates do not prove physical identity or universal long-event recovery. New dataset group, same pretrained detector/runtime, four ordered non-random driving sequences; no independent sites/participants/statistical power claim.

evaluation: All predictions/three repeats/unhooked reference seal before any GT member decompression/parsing. Before tracking only hash untouched labels ZIP and read directory CRC/size metadata. Official clean pinned TrackEval Kitti2DBox pedestrian preprocessing, CLEAR/Identity/HOTA. Native zero-based KITTI xyxy, no MOT GT conversion. Ignore regions/sitting people/truncation/occlusion/height follow official adapter. No leaderboard submission.
input_lock: After freeze, bind full immutable caches, lossless video/pixel manifests, untouched official labels archive/member hashes before first tracking. Same cache across arms; no GT or output selection.

terms.attribution: Andreas Geiger, Philip Lenz, Raquel Urtasun. Are we ready for Autonomous Driving? The KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite. CVPR 2012.
terms.scope: Local noncommercial research only; original images, labels, caches and raw results not redistributed; program AGPL does not relicense dataset.

public_scope: Only source hashes/counts, fixed parameters/rules, aggregate metrics/reasons/risk groups, synthetic tests and numeric figures. Raw matrices, histories, GT, images/IDs, paths and diagnostics local.
